page: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 4.5 GHz AMD EPYC 9V45 processor featuring 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Cache architecture includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster, with hardware vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. System memory totals 768 GB, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU allocation. Local ephemeral storage is bundled with 5,670 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity, while GPU accelerators are absent.

Benchmark testing demonstrates exceptional processing throughput and memory efficiency across diverse metrics. In stress-ng evaluations, the server achieves top-tier results in both single-core and multi-core CPU performance, alongside high PassMark CPU and memory scores. Memory bandwidth reaches 9,789.61 GB/s for cached reads and 174.6 GB/s for large-block writes. Data processing tests show bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 590.13 GB/s and Redis SET operations exceeding 143.37 million operations per second. CPU-based machine learning inference is also notable, generating 339.88 tokens per second on small 135M parameter models and 59.46 tokens per second on 7B models.

The dense pairing of 768 GB RAM with 5,670 GB of local NVMe storage delivers high resource consolidation and qualitative cost efficiency for I/O-heavy environments. Relying on fast local NVMe reduces the necessity and expense of high-throughput networked block storage volumes for scratch and temporary operations. However, workloads requiring persistent data survivability must implement replication strategies, as local NVMe disks are ephemeral. The absence of hardware GPUs also bounds its suitability for larger artificial intelligence training workloads.

Microsoft Azure E96ads_v7 is suitable for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Primary workload fits include large in-memory databases such as Redis and SAP HANA, high-transaction relational databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale ETL data processing pipelines, and enterprise-grade static web serving infrastructure.
description: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture, powered by a 4.5 GHz AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. The configuration provides 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores with multithreading, alongside 768 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Storage consists of a high-speed bundled 5,670 GB local NVMe SSD array, while no dedicated GPUs are provisioned. Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the top tier for multi-core compute, encryption, memory bandwidth, and database transaction throughput, achieving 143.37 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. The hardware exhibits strong CPU-driven large language model inference and high multi-threaded decompression throughput. The pairing of extensive volatile memory with high-capacity local solid-state storage makes the instance cost-efficient for heavy data-processing scenarios that avoid remote storage overhead. This configuration is tailored for large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, relational database engines, and demanding data analytics pipelines.
